meta.description: Shared source of truth for the Palmon Queue Planner. Read by the planner page (client fetch) and, later, the reminder pipeline (GitHub Actions, json.load). Edited by hand: re-anchor FotP per event, overwrite a stage block when a screenshot verifies its rates.

gameClock.note: Fixed UTC-2, no DST. All internal projection math runs on this offset; display in the visitor's local time.

duel.note: Guild Duel: 6 scoring days Mon-Sat, Sunday off. Week boundary Sun 23:00 -> Sat 24:00 server time; per-day themes are modelled on the server calendar weekday (the 23:00 early-start of the boundary is not yet modelled).

days.note: Universal dump day: every speedup type scores. Generals sink here.

scoring.label: Kills / losses (by Armigo level)
scoring.note: 12->48 by Armigo level; awards points for losses too.

days.note: Speedups only (no power points); completions should already have landed.

fotp.note: Front of the Pack: 5 stages of 4h slots, 6 slots/day, each day starting one stage later -> 5-day super-cycle. Re-anchors per event: the opening stage is not stable across events.

anchor.note: Day 1 = Fri Aug 7 00:00 UTC-2. Event duration unverified; past `expires`, reminders flip to a verify-new-event warning instead of announcing a stale rotation.

scoring.label: Train Armigo (per level)
scoring.note: Per-level curve, placeholder; Duel Day-5 list scales 75->338 for Lv1->10.

scoring.label: Training speedup
scoring.note: Magnitude mirrors the Upgrade Buildings shape; awaiting screenshot.

scoring.label: Tech speedup
scoring.note: Magnitude mirrors the Upgrade Buildings shape; awaiting screenshot.

cooldowns.label: Instabuild
cooldowns.note: Counts toward Duel + FotP like speedup minutes, per queue touched (working assumption: up to 8h x 4 queues on a scoring day; verify counter jump on next scoring-day pop). Target phase: Tue -> Thu -> Sat.

cooldowns.label: Instant Build
cooldowns.effect: -600 min on all active build queues
cooldowns.note: Shaves real time for free but destroys burnable minutes. Pop on dead days (Sun/Mon). Do not confuse with Instabuild (camp order).

cooldowns.label: Instant Research
cooldowns.effect: -600 min on all active research queues
cooldowns.note: Same trade-off as Instant Build, for research queues. Pop on dead days.

speedups.generalNote: General speedups count as the type they are spent on for Duel scoring: the flexible reserve, spent last, steered to Friday.
